#.label: Card payment routing (preview)
Choose which card payment provider takes: Choose which card payment provider takes card payments from a checkout. Use the target finder at the top to pick where this applies: the tenant, a group, a store or a single checkout. A value set higher up applies to every checkout below it, unless a checkout has its own.
A checkout can use only one provider at: A checkout can use only one provider at a time. Card terminals that run through an app on the checkout (Adyen local) do not use this page: they are chosen on the tender.
#/properties/connector.label: Card payment provider
#/properties/connector.description: The provider that handles card payments from this checkout through Hii Connect in the cloud. Choose NONE if this checkout should not send card payments through Hii Connect.
Next step: enter your Adyen account once: Next step: enter your Adyen account once under “Adyen (cloud) – account”, then register each checkout's terminal under “Adyen (cloud) – terminals”.
Next step: the Worldline Terminal API ac: Next step: the Worldline Terminal API account and terminals are set up in the Worldline connector configuration app.
Next step: this provider's account and t: Next step: this provider's account and terminals are not on this portal yet. Use the older Hii Connect payment configuration app.
Card payments from this checkout will no: Card payments from this checkout will not be sent through Hii Connect.
NONE: no cloud card provider. Use it for: NONE: no cloud card provider. Use it for checkouts without card payments, or with a terminal that runs through an app on the checkout.
ADYEN_CLOUD: Adyen terminals reached thr: ADYEN_CLOUD: Adyen terminals reached through Adyen's cloud. Needs an Adyen account and a terminal ID per checkout.
NETS_CLOUD: Nets (Nexi) card terminals r: NETS_CLOUD: Nets (Nexi) card terminals reached through the cloud.
SOFTPAY: Softpay, for card payments with: SOFTPAY: Softpay, for card payments with tap to pay on a phone or tablet.
WOTAPI: Worldline terminals through the: WOTAPI: Worldline terminals through the Worldline Terminal API.
